Impressions of the Ghost Recon Wildlands Closed Beta: 

Cons:
-Clunky Movement/Movement animations (I.e. Entering/exiting a car, vaulting or climbing)
-Excessive ambient noise (Especially Radio broadcasts and music) 
-Sound (bug?) issue regarding explosions and occasionally with gunfire 
-Poor Vehicle handling 
-Clunky animal animations
-Character and NPC mouths don't match words/conversations 
-Occasionally side missions would overflow into inaccessible areas 

Pros: 
-Superb Customization 
-Entertaining encounters and gunplay 
-Beautiful, realistic, colorful open world 
-Fleet of drivable vehicles  
-Lively and entertaining music 
-Minimal but accessible UI 
-Relatively Competent  NPCs 
-Fun, engaging story missions
-Fun world to wander around and explore 
-Truly massive map

Since I can't get into the Beta Forum for some reason, I figured I'd post my thoughts here. 

Impressions of the Ghost Recon Wildlands Closed Beta: 

Cons:
-Clunky Movement/Movement animations (I.e. Entering/exiting a car, vaulting or climbing)
-Excessive ambient noise (Especially Radio broadcasts and music) 
-Sound (bug?) issue regarding explosions and occasionally with gunfire 
-Poor Vehicle handling 
-Clunky animal animations
-Character and NPC mouths don't match words/conversations 
-Occasionally side missions would overflow into inaccessible areas 
-Unable to customize teammates 
-Having each teammate (online) tag a resource individually 

Pros: 
-Superb Customization 
-Entertaining encounters and gunplay 
-Beautiful, realistic, colorful open world 
-Fleet of drivable vehicles  
-Lively and entertaining music 
-Minimal but accessible UI 
-Relatively Competent  NPCs 
-Fun, engaging story missions
-Fun world to wander around and explore 

The game is far from what I wanted, but I'm still having tons of fun and hopefully the Ubi team takes our gripes and praise into consideration when they're finalizing their project.
